title: Lặng
about: Round x4 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi"): silence: the sparest of all, a deep sub and pad barely there, a singing bowl now and then and the great bell twice; long empty spaces to rest in. A flat minor at 40 bpm. An original piece.
